mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_alert_notification WHERE provider_message_id = #{message} AND notify_channel = #{channel} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status = 'DELIVERED', sent_at = COALESCE(sent_at, NOW(3)) WHERE id = #{id} AND notify_status IN ('SENT','DELIVERED')
UPDATE t_alert_notification SET last_provider_code = 'CONNECTED', last_error_summary = '电话已接通，等待按1确认' WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status = 'FAILED', next_attempt_at = NOW(3), last_provider_code = #{event}, last_error_type = 'PROVIDER_RECEIPT_FAILURE', last_error_summary = #{summary} WHERE id = #{id} AND notify_status IN ('SENT','DELIVERED')
